title: Unbreakable Tool
description: This mod makes all tools unbreakable by completely disabling durability, so you can use them forever without worrying about repairs.
body:
![Bisect Partner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3deb9b7a1b2b239eda2f53c0eb958d3bbee35d6a.png)
[Pormo Code: https://bisecthosting.com/Snokayy](https://bisecthosting.com/Snokayy)

This mod removes the durability system from tools in your game, making every tool completely unbreakable. Once crafted, your tools will never lose durability, no matter how much you use them.

Say goodbye to constantly repairing or replacing your equipment — pickaxes, axes, shovels, and more will last forever. This allows you to focus entirely on building, mining, and exploring without interruption.

Perfect for players who prefer a more relaxed gameplay experience or simply want to eliminate the grind of maintaining tools, this mod ensures your gear is always ready for action.
